paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Results of DPR with corpus, document, and asymmetric expansion on the dev set of MS-Marco.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) performance of different variants of Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) as the number of queries used during inference (S) increases from 1 to 10, evaluated on the dev set of MS-Marco. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and ranges from 1 to 10 on a linear scale, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and ranges from 33.0 to 36.0, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Four lines are shown: a black solid line representing "DPR w/o query" (which is not visible in the plot, likely due to being below the y-axis range or omitted); a red solid line with circular markers for "DPR w/ corpus expansion", which starts at approximately 35.2 and increases to around 35.7 before stabilizing; a green solid line with triangular markers for "DPR w/ document expansion", which remains relatively flat around 34.9 to 35.0 across all S values; and a blue dashed line with star markers for "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion", which begins at about 34.8, rises to 35.1 at S=3, then gradually declines to approximately 34.5 at S=10.
